sources.title: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B - QwenCloud
sources.snippet: The Qwen3.5 Series 35B-A3B is a native vision-language model designed with a hybrid architecture that integrates linear attention mechanisms and a sparse mixture-of-experts model, achieving higher inference efficiency. Its overall performance is comparable to that of the Qwen3.5-27B.

sources.snippet: Qwen 3.7 stayed closed and is now a skipped generation. Start with our Qwen3.8-27B complete guide and the Qwen 3.8 Max guide; this pillar remains the canonical reference for the 3.5 family. Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B is still the MLX-on-Mac coding favourite; no 3.8 Coder variant has shipped.
